purpose: Honest residual unknowns, the conclusion each one limits, and the CNY million exposure it affects. Nothing here is filled with a made-up value, and a conditional forecast is not turned into null just to look cautious.

unknowns.unknown: No disclosed H2 FY2026 (or FY2027/FY2028) revenue split between small-molecule D&M and the Chemistry residual (R plus other chemistry services).
unknowns.limits_conclusion: Whether the ~35.3% implied H2 D&M growth and the ~2.05x FY2028 D&M requirement are plausible; the blended non-TIDES activity index cannot be validated at component level.
unknowns.why_not_resolved: The issuer discloses segment totals and D&M H1 only; a subgroup H2 split is not published and cannot be derived without inventing it.
unknowns.what_would_resolve_it: A future interim/annual report with H2 or full-year D&M disclosure, or a management quantification of the residual.

unknowns.unknown: No realized net price, discount, mix or currency-decomposition series for Chemistry, TIDES or non-TIDES.
unknowns.limits_conclusion: Whether the 0.97/0.99/1.00 price indices are the right order of magnitude; the only disclosed price evidence is margin pressure for Testing and Biology.
unknowns.why_not_resolved: Price and mix are not separately disclosed; the p16 paragraph is a margin statement for two other segments.
unknowns.what_would_resolve_it: Same-scope Chemistry price/mix disclosure or a management pricing commentary with a quantified effect.

unknowns.unknown: No reactor utilisation, yield, qualified output or annual throughput; the >4,000 kL and >100,000 L capacity figures are installed-volume stocks.
unknowns.limits_conclusion: Whether the capacity ramp can physically deliver the implied H2 and FY2028 workload; the model cannot test a physical ceiling.
unknowns.why_not_resolved: Installed volume is disclosed; utilisation and qualified output are not. Converting litres to revenue would require an invented ASP or yield.
unknowns.what_would_resolve_it: Disclosed utilisation, batch counts or revenue-per-litre economics with a stated basis.

unknowns.unknown: No measured cancellation rate, no opening-cohort realisation schedule, and no H1 recognition of the FY2025 year-end RPO cohort.
unknowns.limits_conclusion: The 80% catch-up / 20% cancellation split in the stress input is a stated condition, not a measured recovery; the RPO expected amount cannot be reconciled to actual recognition.
unknowns.why_not_resolved: The disclosure gives a stock and an expected point, not a cohort roll-forward.
unknowns.what_would_resolve_it: A contract-liability/RPO roll-forward or management disclosure of opening-cohort recognition.

unknowns.unknown: One customer exceeds 10% of group revenue and is described as coming from Chemistry and other segments; no exact share, identity or subgroup allocation.
unknowns.limits_conclusion: Whether the largest driver is concentrated in one relationship; no subgroup split can be asserted and no share can be allocated to D&M or TIDES.
unknowns.why_not_resolved: The filing gives a threshold statement only.
unknowns.what_would_resolve_it: A named-customer disclosure or a concentration table with amounts.

unknowns.unknown: No frozen historical forecast for this company and no observed range for any forecast parameter; observed_range stays null in every calibration.
unknowns.limits_conclusion: The forecast cannot be called empirically calibrated, and Low/Base/High cannot be called a probability interval. This is a genuine adequacy limit, not a code defect.
unknowns.why_not_resolved: No immutable past forecast exists in the record; manufacturing one would be fabrication.
unknowns.what_would_resolve_it: A frozen prior forecast evaluated against realised revenue, or a disclosed same-scope observed range.

unknowns.unknown: No forward operating mechanism is disclosed for Other business or the discontinued perimeter.
unknowns.limits_conclusion: Their forward paths are an uncalibrated runoff condition (Other) and a reported zero (discontinued); neither can be attributed to a growth mechanism.
unknowns.why_not_resolved: The only available evidence is a historical decline row and an accounting classification note.
unknowns.what_would_resolve_it: A segment-level operating description for Other, or a continuing-operation disclosure for the disposed business.

unknowns.unknown: The peer (Bachem) evidence is a contrary commercial-timing example in CHF with a different molecule and customer mix; no like-for-like transfer rate exists.
unknowns.limits_conclusion: No peer growth or margin rate can be transferred into this forecast, and the peer is disclosed only as counterevidence.
unknowns.why_not_resolved: Different currency, perimeter and product mix; a transfer would be an analogy, not evidence.
unknowns.what_would_resolve_it: A same-scope peer dataset with matched currency, perimeter and period.

not_unknown_but_limited: The six-partition reconciliation and the TIDES single-count are arithmetic identities and are verified.
The 49-claim union coverage is verified; the remaining limit is economic, not bookkeeping.
The native main/stress chain is complete and byte-bound; a clean chain is not economic acceptance.

Six FY2026 conditional bridges keep the reason 'conversion_assumption_not_disclosed'. This is a real structural signal, not an input defect: those bridges declare the FY2026 activity index as a conversion input, but the activity index is supported as mechanism_direction (it IS the operating mechanism), not as a conversion_assumption. The projection therefore cannot see a conversion claim covering it. Renaming the activity claim to conversion_assumption purely to clear the diagnostic would mislabel a mechanism as a conversion, so the diagnostic is left standing and disclosed here.
All twelve calibrations stay 'unverified' with observed_range=null. That is the honest status: no same-scope observed range exists.
no_fabrication_statement: No ASP, utilisation, cancellation rate, cohort schedule or empirical range was invented anywhere in this package. Where a number was needed and not disclosed, it is a labelled analyst condition with its falsifier, or it is listed above as unknown.
